summary: Read a singly linked list of integer nodes. Values may repeat and may be negative. Arrange the nodes into non-decreasing order and write the list. The total of comparisons and moves must stay on the order of n times log n, where n is the number of nodes. Extra space may be only a fixed few pointers and counters. Do not create new nodes in order to copy values. Adjust the existing links only. An empty list or a one-node list stays as it is.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is a node count followed by the integer stored in each node.
